subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation known as SAARC is a regional organization aimed at promoting cooperation among its member countries. Initially it had seven member countries and Afghanistan was included later. The first conference of SAARC was held in Dhaka in 1985. Bangladesh played a significant role in the formation of SAARC. Its secretariat is located in Nepal and is headed by a Secretary General. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 236
